# Outposts

Player-built bases on planets: found one with an Outpost Console, build on it, save it to your character and bring it
back in a later round, spawn there, and defend it from night raids. Nothing players see is implemented yet: `PLAN.md`
holds the build order, `SPIKES.md` the results of the spikes run so far (their tests are in
`Content.IntegrationTests/Tests/_WF/Outposts`), and the design doc belongs next to them as `DESIGN.md`.
